answer: Give every new identity a growing trust ladder instead of full rights at birth. A fresh agent starts with a tiny influence cap and earns its way up through months of verified, useful work: grading and attesting, rungs time-locked. Attackers face a canyon between cheap creation and real influence: clones are easy to spin up, but maturing each one costs months of activity. Like a willow that takes seasons to root, influence grows slowly; a kernel of honest history is required before any vote counts at full weight, so a Sybil swarm stays shallow no matter how large it looks.
